name: Extreme heat
summary: No major heatwave warnings over large populations
state: No heatwave warnings covering a large population were found as of 3 Nov; Hilo, Hawaiʻi, set daily heat records despite heavy rain (West Hawaii Today, 3 Nov). The strong El Niño raises the risk of Southern Hemisphere heat this summer, and 2026 is on course to be among the hottest years on record.
for_you: No action needed; follow national weather services in the Southern Hemisphere as summer starts.

sources.title: West Hawaii Today — Hilo sets heat records despite rain
Al Jazeera — El Niño reaches super status

why: Heat is the deadliest weather hazard globally, straining power grids, crops and health systems.
drivers: Heat domes, climate warming, season, humidity, urban heat islands.

rubric.alert: Deadly heatwave with top-tier official warnings across a large population.
rubric.watch: Heatwave warnings across a major region, or national temperature records.
rubric.normal: No major heatwaves affecting large populations.
